Name: Stardew Valley Classic Harvest Moon Audio Overhaul
Author: Healicious
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]

Do you miss the music and sounds from the classic Harvest Moon games? This mod replaces some of the music and sound effects in Stardew Valley with audio from [b]Harvest Moon: Back to Nature[/b] and [b]Story of Seasons: Friends of Mineral Town[/b].

I created this mod because I love these classic farming games and want to enjoy their familiar music and sounds while playing Stardew Valley. When I first started playing Stardew Valley, its music and atmosphere brought back so many memories of the classic Harvest Moon games. I looked for a similar mod, but the ones I found were either outdated or had sound effects that didn't feel right. Sometimes, I would even turn off my mod and switch back to the original Stardew Valley music because I still enjoyed listening to the vanilla OST.
That's when I decided to create my own mod, bringing together my love for Stardew Valley and the nostalgia of the classic Harvest Moon games. ❤️

If you grew up playing these games, I hope this mod brings back some good memories!

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url].[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Download and extract this mod.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Put the mod folder into your Stardew Valley [b]Mods[/b] [/color][color=#D4D4D8]folder.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Launch the game through SMAPI and enjoy![/color][/*]
[/list]
[b][size=4]Main features[/size][/b]

[list]
[*][b]Classic Harvest Moon music[/b] — Enjoy music from Story of Seasons: Friends of Mineral Town and Harvest Moon: Back to Nature.[/*]
[*][b]Seasonal music[/b] — Replace the music for Spring, Summer, Fall, and Winter.[/*]
[*][b]Weekend music[/b] — Enjoy the classic weekend music from Friends of Mineral Town.[/*]
[*][b]Classic sound effects[/b] — Replace some Stardew Valley sound effects with sounds from Harvest Moon: Back to Nature.[/*]
[*][b]A nostalgic experience[/b] — Enjoy Stardew Valley with the music and sounds from the classic farming games.[/*]
[/list]This mod only changes music and sound effects. The original gameplay and graphics remain unchanged.

[heading]Development Status & Known Issues[/heading]
This mod is still a work in progress!
I'm playing Stardew Valley myself, and I've only reached [b]Summer of Year 1[/b] so far. Many features are still locked, so I haven't found all the sound effects that need to be replaced.
For example, sounds for sheep, horses, and other animals or activities may still be the original Stardew Valley sounds.

There are also a few things you should know:
[list]
[*][b]Music looping:[/b] Some music tracks may not loop perfectly. You might notice a small gap or an imperfect transition when the music repeats.[/*]
[*][b]Music volume:[/b] Some music may be louder than the original Stardew Valley music. You can use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39506]this mod[/url] to adjust the music volume to your liking.[/*]
[*][b]Some sound effects cannot be replaced:[/b] Not every sound effect can be replaced easily. Some sounds may require changes to the game's code, which are outside the scope of this mod. For example, I haven't replaced the sound when moving items around in the inventory menu, as the sound also played when collecting products, such as milk from a cow.[/*]
[/list]
I'll continue updating this mod as I play further and discover more sounds to replace.
If you find any missing sound effects, feel free to let me know! Your feedback is always welcome.
Thanks for trying my mod, and happy farming! 🌱

[b]Image Credits:[/b] The header and gallery images were created with the help of ChatGPT (OpenAI).
